metadata.title: Retro Sidescroller Demo (SMB Spirit - Wall Clip)
metadata.description: Playable SMB-spirit sidescroller reference cartridge (P2-D). A 256x240 virtual-pixel level on the fixed-tick retro layer (8.8 fixed point, 60 Hz) where the subpixel wall clip genuinely emerges from midline ejection: run at the thin wall at full speed and the right subpixel alignment ejects you out the far side. C/X reproduce the exact clipping/blocked alignments; T toggles modern vs retro ejection.
